Enrich person.name: Brian Blalock
Enrich person.title: SVP, Head of Healthcare Operations
Enrich person.summary:
Senior operations and business transformation executive with 25+ years of experience building high-performing teams at Fortune 500 companies including Fidelity Investments, eBay, UnitedHealth Group, and General Electric. Led global organizations of 1,000+ employees across operations, sales, client services, and management consulting.  Consistently delivered double-digit revenue growth, 30%+ efficiency improvements, and cultural transformations by leading complex turnarounds, scaling operations, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

What I Do Best:
I specialize in turning around underperforming organizations - driving scale, improving service, enhancing client experience, and building a culture of excellence.

My approach is simple: empower frontline teams with clear vision and direction, embrace transparency and accountability, relentlessly simplify processes, eliminate bureaucracy that doesn't serve customers, and invest in a culture that allows every associate to be successful.

What Drives Me:
I believe the best leaders don't just optimize systems - we unlock human potential.  Leading people is a tremendous responsibility. When you give them the right tools, clear expectations, and genuine development opportunities, they don't just outperform at work - they grow as professionals and people. That ripple effect beyond the office is what makes my work matter.

Recent Impact:
	• Transformed healthcare operations, improved the service quality to  99% from mid 80s, while dramatically improving scale by over 30%
	• Scaled a client service organization, tripling the number of associates to over 1k in under 3 years, supporting 70% YoY growth while improving client satisfaction
	• Led global Account Management operation with 900+ account managers and 100+ sales operations professionals across US, EU, and Asia that drove over $50M in sales
	• Transformed culture, improving employee engagement from low 30s to 79% during rapid expansion - proving you don't have to sacrifice culture for growth
	• Built process improvement teams that delivered millions in cost savings, drove double-digit revenue growth, and improved quality for our clients 
	
Open to: Chief Operating Officer roles, Board positions, and advisory opportunities with companies ready to scale operations without sacrificing service quality or culture. Open to opportunities in the greater Austin area or remote executive roles.
